entries.german: Bürgermeister, Schultheiß und Gemeinde zu Boxberg geben dem Ritter Jörg von Rosenberg Güter, die zu seinem Hof in Boxberg gehören, und die sie von ihm gekauft hatten, um 538 Gulden wiederzukaufen und quittieren darüber.
entries.english: The mayor, Schultheiß and municipality of Boxberg give the knight Jörg von Rosenberg estates that belong to his farm in Boxberg and which they had bought from him to repurchase and acknowledge 538 guilders.
facts: Jörg von Rosenberg is titled Ritter
The Bürgermeister, Schultheiss und Gemeinde zu Boxberg repurchased goods belonging to the Hof of Jörg von Rosenberg in Boxberg
The goods repurchased had previously been purchased from Jörg von Rosenberg
The Bürgermeister, Schultheiss und Gemeinde zu Boxberg issued a quittance for the repurchase
